verified_against: SDG&E Schedule GR (Domestic Natural Gas Service), 'GR' column. Sheet 1 rates: Cal. P.U.C. Sheet 63647-G, Advice Ltr. 3533-G, effective Jul 10 2026. Sheet 2 baseline allowances: Cal. P.U.C. Sheet 26187-G, Advice Ltr. 3127-G, effective Nov 1 2022.

notes.shape: SDG&E residential gas is far simpler than electric: one schedule (GR), no TOU, no NEM, no CCA generation choice. So no plans array, no hour blocks, no non-bypassable charges. A bill is (therms in baseline tier x baseline rate) + (therms above baseline x non-baseline rate), floored at the minimum bill.
notes.no_climate_zones: Unlike the electric baseline, Schedule GR's allowance is territory-wide — a single set of therms/day figures, NOT split by climate zone. The calculator's climate-zone selector does not apply to gas. Sheet 2 lists one allowance per seasonal period with no zone dimension.
notes.three_seasonal_periods: The allowance has THREE periods, not two: Summer (May-Oct), Winter On-Peak (Dec/Jan/Feb), Winter Off-Peak (Nov/Mar/Apr). This is a gas-specific split; do not reuse the electric file's summer/winter boundaries.
notes.flat_rates: The baseline and non-baseline per-therm rates do NOT vary by month. The GR baseline rate is Procurement 0.32485 + Transmission 1.97369 = 2.29854; non-baseline is Procurement 0.32485 + Transmission 2.34201 = 2.66686. The tiering lives entirely in the transmission charge. Only the allowance changes with season, which changes how many therms land in each tier.
notes.procurement_varies_monthly: The Procurement Charge (0.32485) bundles the GPC/GPC-A charges from Schedule GPC and is reset monthly (Schedule GR Sheet 1 note 2, Special Condition 7). This file carries the snapshot in force on the effective date; a bill from another month uses a slightly different procurement component.
notes.columns_not_used: Sheet 1 also prints GR-C (a cross-over procurement option for customers over 50,000 therms/yr) and GTC/GTCA (transportation-only, no procurement). Neither is the standard individually-metered residential rate; only the GR column is used here.
notes.unmodeled: A real GR bill also carries small per-therm surcharges from separate schedules — G-PUC (PUC reimbursement fee), G-PPPS (public purpose program surcharge), and a franchise fee — plus the semi-annual California Climate Credit. These are not in the Schedule GR rate table and are not modeled. They are a few cents per therm; for a fuel-switching comparison the ~2.30-2.67/therm transportation+procurement rate dominates.
notes.care: CARE customers receive a 20% discount as a separate line item (Schedule G-CARE). Not modeled; the minimum-bill CARE figure is recorded for reference only.

minimum_bill._source: Schedule GR Sheet 1, note 3. Minimum bill = per_day x days in billing cycle (~$4/month non-CARE, ~$3.20/month CARE). Effective May 1 2020.

baseline_periods._source: Schedule GR Sheet 2, Special Condition 3 (Baseline Usage), therms per day. Territory-wide, no climate zone.

rates_per_therm._source: Schedule GR Sheet 1, 'GR' column. Total Baseline Charge and Total Non-Baseline Charge (Procurement + Transmission).
